Table 3.1 step 1 points to Table 3.2 for initialization, but initialization is Table 3.3; use page/step locators.
Table 3.1 step 7(b)(ii) stress correction typography conflicts with clean flow Eqs 35-37; use no invented repair.
Chapter 2 pressure formulas and Table 3.3 host tension-positive negative compression require one explicit boundary/sign map; Table 3.3 trace notation is ambiguous.
Table 3.3 leaves sigma11=0, xi_R=0 and Mfin=Mcut equality branches unspecified; hydrostatic Lode direction and Ado 0/0 limit not resolved.
Minimum pressure prose (p72), low-pressure formulas and signed Table 3.3 min bounds must be reconciled.
Table 3.2 steps 19/20 both update reversal anchors; old/new snapshot order and strain accumulator role unresolved.
Initial zpeak is positive epsilon while prose sometimes says zpeak=0 before dilation; retain explicit initialization discrepancy.
Fabric product z^ij:p is not a well-typed scalar contraction; norm/sign, zxpPk versus pzp,peak aliases and strict peak comparisons unresolved.
z_alpha initialized but evolution unidentified; no unsupported minimal state count.
